rows.grounds: passive present form meaning is said or called
compound adjective giving the verse count

items.question: Which Purāṇa is said to contain twelve thousand ślokas?
items.inference: The Brahmakaivarta Purāṇa is said to contain twelve thousand ślokas.
uncertainties: token four is a numeral-sloka count rather than standard Sanskrit
its exact grammatical role is unclear
items.plain_english: It is called the Brahmakaivarta, that twelve-thousand-verse Purāṇa.
